title: The Essential Commodities Act, 1955
full_text: The Essential Commodities Act, 1955 null Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 195510 Act Number: 10 Enactment Date: 1955-04-01 Act Year: 1955 Short Title: The Essential Commodities Act, 1955 Long Title: An Act to provide, in the interest of the general public, for the control of the production, supply and distribution of, and trade and commerce, in certain commodities.
